notes.title: Early Access Update 5: Raw material mining
notes.content:
[p]Before I get into the details of update 5, I have a special announcement: Mars First Logistics will be coming out of Early Access on [b]26 September 2025[/b]! Here's the announcement trailer:

[/p][previewyoutube="aaYWZYpSgW4;full"][/previewyoutube][p] With that out the way, let's get into what's in update 5, which is out today: [/p][p][/p][h2]Raw material mining[/h2][p][/p][p]Probably the biggest change is that structures like roads and monorails now cost raw materials. Raw materials can be found on rocks and there are new parts for mining them: the drill and mining laser. There is also a scanner for more easily locating raw material deposits. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/79ea3e3a1975ba8f454464dc7cf2361b0a4c042f.png"][/img][/p][p]There is a new main contract to deliver some volatile explosives that unlocks the drill part and introduces raw material mining. The scanner and mining laser can be unlocked by completing side jobs.

The other big change is to the order of main contracts. Now the biosphere, rocket launch site and fair areas unlock after completing the resort/sports area. This was done to more gradually introduce raw material mining. Roads also now unlock later in the game - they were maybe a bit OP to unlock so early.

[/p][h2]New parts[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/1f5c6940df13a97d27a4efbc8e867f8d94120a97.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/f6ff3dba0998670eef06e5531f3ebd292a4f1649.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/a64e61560533e96941c40df48c7b1470fb5c169c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/b139938abe13c34b8679420eb6f099341a4e5f07.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c1f42dcf9b63cdd142951eb1f1dc1762f381d7f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/a84deabf1839b255776222d1413ae088b10e710c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/b90bc733da65291bba5f6ddfc648c4a7db249abd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/1007b183fd32217efa26e78464acc6b597c6f21a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/b8703e13e5af64da6aa7af8d5e3bac168c7cbbd6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/dfac4a2539eb4ac7a322cad8a78a6340e236ffad.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/88f638d9952ab9a576594896b4edd504d1f19dba.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/a1fda68b2048b1732b7436a24376a1fbf7f4d65c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/3fbc6dc8d7fc0f7871cab718b13aa9db93a29396.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/26c79a513bb189899e962cc8df5cdbd285c784d0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/72761513ac620fce7750034d1ee81bad3f1dfec1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/04d9a2134b9a3e48ca4a10419c0b638337c1ecd1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/b82c8a82e70855d7b5052a3f1578050c232d52bc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/ac853b0a03d2ae1b244c6ff093ce37af015cf965.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/29db68149b1274cf4428dc9ec0b622b56173b8c1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/19bedab751d6faef00cc7da164cc9bd4271e8688.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Reaction Control System (RCS):[/b] This allows for control of pitch, roll and yaw when flying and is unlocked with a blueprint after completing the main contract to build a road.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera: [/b]Activate to play in first-person mode! You can attach multiple cameras and switch between the different views too.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-connector: [/b]This part can be used to bridge short gaps that otherwise don't line up neatly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster Wheel: [/b]A very big wheel![/p][/*][*][p][b]Spiked Wheel: [/b]Provides extra grip.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Electro Magnet: [/b]Makes it easier to pit up metal objects or attach to metal surfaces. Only becomes available as a side job reward after completing all main contracts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Copier: [/b]Allows copying other player's designs in co-op.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavy Duty Servo: [/b]Has very high torque.[/p][/*][*][p]And a few more surprises...[/p][/*][/list][p]The grappling hook also has a new look and it can now be extended as well as retracted.[/p][p]  [/p][h2]Transparent Paint[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/b04410b82cb89b0fd586fd81f3be0a860358dda2.png"][/img][/p][p]Most parts can now be made transparent!

[/p][h2]Fuel pumps[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/849e88e4f347201349a9827273f7e6178c6ee1e3.png"][/img][/p][p]Terminals at stations now refuel you instead of the station as a whole. They have their own little fuel pumps and the refuel radius has been reduced.

[/p][h2]Remote outposts[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/e8f4c5cbbc4dc712c259865b4b609ca4d3e11ed1.png"][/img][/p][p]Procedurally placed stations now all start off as remote outposts which are upgraded to functional buildings, such as a factory or habitat, when a side jobs to the station is completed. I think this change makes it feel more like you're directly contributing to the expansion of the settlement.

[/p][h2]Terrain changes [/h2][list][*][p] Subtle shading has been added to the terrain to better highlight small bumps.[/p][/*][*][p] There is now snow on high peaks and the terrain is in general slightly more colourful.[/p][/*][*][p] Rare ice or mud lakes may be encountered throughout the world.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c95c151e945eea0eb5cc9406b30f118f6806dd83.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Monorail changes[/h2][list][*][p]Monorail trains can now be summoned at any station with a completed monorail (there is a new button on the station platform for this purpose).[/p][/*][*][p]Monorail trains also now travel faster and the shunt has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]There are more monorail stations on the map and they get their own icon indicating their direction.[/p][/*][*][p]The above changes should hopefully make monorails more useful! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other changes[/h2][list][*][p]When binding keys in settings, conflicts are now allowed. Conflicting bindings will simply be unset and a warning will be shown. This should make it less tedious to rebind keys.[/p][/*][*][p]A "night mode" setting has been added. This darkens the editor and splash screen backgrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]The pitch of structures like roads, pipes and monorails can now be adjusted using the W/S keys (or left stick). Note that, for gamepads, the default binding to rotate structures is now also the left stick so that dpad up/down can remain zoom.[/p][/*][*][p]Water pipes are now easier to drive on using the magnetic wheels.[/p][/*][*][p]Resetting while flying no longer transports you all the way back down to the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]It's now possible to bind the numpad keys separately from the number row keys (although their glyphs are the same).[/p][/*][*][p]When resetting, the vehicle is now oriented to the camera direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Race wheel handing has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Magnetic wheel speed has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The radius where a road or other structure will connect to a station is now shown.[/p][/*][*][p]Roads now end further away from stations and have a little on-ramp. You may need to re-create some roads for their end-position to change.[/p][/*][*][p]The distance to structure connection points is now shown.[/p][/*][*][p]The top speed when flying has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Your rover now has a little home garage where you start the game.[/p][/*][*][p]How side job pickup points are calculated has been overhauled and now pickups can be inside buildings (e.g. a warehouse). Previously they always had to be out in the open. This change also fixes the bug where parcels would sometimes spawn on roads.[/p][/*][*][p]Structures are also now always fully refunded if destroyed. The previous behaviour of structures only refunding if they weren't complete was confusing to a lot of players.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ore Hauler, Rocket and Grappler blueprints have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]The theodolite now has an aim dot and the way connection points are selected has been tweaked. The aim dot can be disabled in settings.[/p][/*][*][p]The high speed motor now has arrows indicating it's forward direction.[/p][/*][*][p]The mass of the Weight part has been doubled.[/p][/*][*][p]After completing the fair, there is now one whirlwind remaining, in case you want to go for a whirlwind ride.[/p][/*][*][p]In co-op, all parts and structures that are unlocked for the host will become unlocked for joining players when they join. [/p][/*][*][p]The part inventory in the editor is now divided into sections, with undiscovered parts getting their own section at the end.[/p][/*][*][p]Some parts now have a brief description under their title in the editor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with incorrect obstruction errors when placing transmitters in co-op.[/p][/*][*][p]Many other smaller fixes. [/p][/*][/list][p]
I hope you enjoy the update! The next major update will be version 1.0 on 26 September 2025!



[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Update 4: Roads and Trains!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thanks for your patience while we worked on this update. I realise this has taken a little longer than the previous updates, but it's also a big new feature! 

[previewyoutube=Je647q4NTOs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New structure building system[/h1]

This update introduces only one new part, the theodolite:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c9f31b573ec2e67fc8b1446e77be338e3e8a1946.png[/img]

If you don't know what a theodolite is, you're not alone. I didn't know what it was either until we added it to the game, but you've probably seem one if you've ever seen engineers surveying a building site. They'll often be aiming one at someone holding a measuring stick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/02d19472f6a74e82b8e65288e8fb6d88695179c2.png[/img]

With the theodolite, you can build structures such as roads, monorails, power lines, water pipes and fuel pipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/0d8a9ee442ae532a7b8d689d5470f44b2067b370.png[/img]

A new contract type has been added that tasks you with connecting different stations using various structures. For example you might be asked to build a water pipe between a reservoir and a habitat. You are, however, free to build structures wherever you like.

Transmitters are now also structures that you need to build yourself instead of discovering. They have a small cost and need to have line-of-site to each other, which brings a new dynamic to exploring the landscape.

The theodolite part is unlocked with the new Scout blueprint (pictured above) which replaces the Buggy blueprint.

[h1]New parcels[/h1]

New road-trip themed parcels have been added:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c583ae090e935059c68946ff9f82f602c6e094fd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/da6c8706fe20392da459690ccab557be24ab2bc9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/86d1541f070963fb44dcefec8ab07b7b6da75747.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/a960c12953998112f329280fdba282d817c45a03.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/da7be26c2333bf1da378ba566aa4aee22b77249b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/213f3496d7e70f536fe197cb99881161c8d0cc4f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/335362a15a35bf2183e55bb3a628a253cf80b7df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/990eb6f85f28a684ba84ab461603100c633cdbde.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/be3c192768f88c5d17cca7bc5ded7bf56d2143fb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/ee1fa95c4777fb18af870f81782cc15cb128e841.png[/img][/url]

along with a few more...

[h1]Clouds[/h1]

Did you know that [url=https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/nasas-curiosity-rover-captures-shining-clouds-on-mars]clouds do sometimes occur on Mars[/url]? In the interests of being a 100% totally accurate simulation of Mars, they're now in the game too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/075704aff30e700bc2d5beca98bcd11942dc1a65.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/a2c548331eaa01843fd518d516917a291fb7f809.png[/img]

[h1]Other stuff[/h1]

We also fixed and tweaked a few things:
[list]
[*]Increased camera zoom.
[*]The grapple hook now works on terrain by default.
[*]The fair contracts are now unlocked together with the other areas, giving you more options from the start.
[*]More accurate map fog.
[*]Fixed a bug with the wind turbine delivery zone in co-op.
[*]Various other minor fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

[h1]Future plans[/h1]

I feel like we've just scratched the surface of where this new system could go. For example I'm thinking it might be nice to integrate rocket refueling with the fuel pipe lines. Perhaps you have to connect stations to the fuel grid before you can refuel at them?

I'd love to hear your ideas of what new structures you'd like to see in the game.

The next update will probably be more incremental improvements and features, based on your feedback, followed by something new next year and then we should be getting close to 1.0!

I hope you enjoy the update!

Ian.

notes.title: Early Access Update 3
notes.content:
Hello,

This update is mostly about oft-requested quality of life improvements, but also adds some new parts to play with.

[h2]Mechanical loops[/h2]

The biggest change is to the way parts connect together. Previously each part had exactly one "prong" that would slot into a socket on another part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/7c251b45d6f3994e65263d3dae21626fc079d62e.png[/img]

This was often a source of confusion, as the prong isn't visible when you're attaching a part. With this update there are no more prongs. Instead any socket can connect to any other socket and you won't end up with small gaps when you try to close a loop. The gap was there to show the parts weren't mechanically linked, but now they are, so no gap is necessary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/d6f182e98ce012dae6ecffd23489c02f8c367ac8.png[/img]

The ability to create mechanical loops opens up many more creative and engineering possibilities, such as more sophisticated suspension systems, or the ability to combine multiple servos or pistons for greater lifting power.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Since sockets will now form mechanical linkages with adjacent sockets, some of your saved vehicles may not work as expected. If you find that something is not moving that previously moved, it's likely because two sockets are now linked. You can fix this by separating the sockets or using different parts that do not have a socket in that position. See below for new parts that have been added for this purpose.

[h2]Select pivot point[/h2]

Since parts can now connect via any socket, it made sense to allow you to select the socket when attaching parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/6d681be0d144e80f833e783abf205a3847d7d91d.gif[/img]

This feature can also be used to easily flip servos to have them rotate in the opposite direction.

[h2]In-game manual[/h2]

The game now features an "Engineer's Handbook" that can be accessed from the editor. It explains some of the finer points of editing such as copy-pasting, changing channels, etc, that were previously not explained very well. This feature is a work-in-progress and new sections will be added over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/80053f9abea5ef822857f72a1d639a296b5e60e0.png[/img]

[h2]Cleaned up part controls UI[/h2]

The part controls display has been cleaned up and it now avoids showing duplicate prompts for the same part type with the same controls. Previously this could be very messy with a lot of controllable parts. It also no longer shows part controls every time you switch channels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/771dbbbaf0f28b7e4fe4a0be89dd51f7de89f0d6.png[/img]

[h2]Grappling hook improvements[/h2]

When aiming the grappling hook, the vehicle will become invisible in a circle around the target. This makes it much easier to aim without your vehicle getting in the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/0e6f92053a51175b0189b82d69468d0c36b9eb83.gif[/img]

We've also fixed some physics issues with the grappling hook.

[h2]New parts[/h2]

A total of 8 new parts have been added:

[h3]Sliders[/h3]

These are free-sliding linear joints and come in 3 lengths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/3170532c779d7fb3ed136ed0afa5a7891c5e0778.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/080ba4fefb4d6e063f536752855660177bf8bc39.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/2003b9dfa6a196b5371048ea10a5e15fb4bb1cff.png[/img]

[h3]New connectors[/h3]

T-connector, X-connector and corner parts have been added. These are particularly useful to avoid unintended linkages, since they have less sockets than the hub part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/71b44c589f65ae5edbac6479bae883a778f52d1f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/7b4b4cca58466301d02076c04ddf5360395f430a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/d0cd31685668e5cd2401e1ddf2506df6a384f499.png[/img]

[h3]Ribbon[/h3]

Unlock the ribbon by completing the fair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/269052c0e51d5e63a05bea7c6a304c2187d59ae4.gif[/img]

[h3]Radio[/h3]

Allows you to play music all the time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/d4bca02146d3beb25c84b5ec36904d02f9a94573.png[/img]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The race track now has a lap timer.
[*] The motorised joint part now has a direction arrow.
[*] The dimensions of some parts such as the Telescoping Cylinder, Hinge, Ball Joint, 30 Degree Bend and Angled Connector have been slightly modified to better line up with the other parts. This may cause issues with existing saved vehicles, since the positions of parts might change slightly.
[*] New pivot points have been added to some parts such as the jaws, cone and horn.
[*] The reversed curved panel parts have been removed, since they are no longer necessary as the non-reversed versions can now be used instead by selecting a different pivot.
[*] Controllable parts such as servos and cylinders can now be set to auto-return when no button is pressed. Access this setting in the configure controls tab in the editor.
[*] Editor zoom limit has been increased.
[*] A new setting has been added to disable the input prompts in the bottom-left of the map, editor and menus.
[*] Steam Deck performance has been improved.
[*] Numerous other tweaks and bug fixes.
[/list]

Thanks for the continued feedback and I hope you enjoy the update! The next update will focus on new content.

notes.title: Big change to editor/physics in beta branch
notes.content:
Hello,

I've just pushed a big change to how the editor and physics work to the beta branch. 

The new system allows mechanical loops and selecting the pivot point when attaching parts. This is a major change to how the building works and I'm hoping it will allow more creative possibilities, while still being intuitive and easy to understand.

There are some outstanding usability issues that I talk about in the following video, but on the whole I think this is a very positive change that many of you will enjoy.

[previewyoutube=ewdjMxuEXWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Summary of changes:

[list]
[*] Connecting parts in mechanical loops is now supported!
[*] There are no longer small gaps when you try to close a loop,  instead the parts will become mechanically bonded if their sockets line up. This may cause issues with some of your existing builds, which may need to be modified to break any undesired connections.
[*] You can now select different pivot points about which to rotate parts, and you can connect them via any free socket.
[*] The editor now includes a work-in-progress "Engineers's Handbook" to help you get the most out of the editor.
[*] Some part dimensions have been standardized to make it easier to link them with other parts. These include the telescoping cylinder, hinge and ball joint. This may break some existing builds.
[*] New pivot points have been added to some parts such as the jaws,  cone and horn.
[*] The reversed curved panel parts have been removed, since they are no longer necessary as the non-reversed versions can now be used instead by selecting a different pivot.
[*] New parts: short, medium and large sliders.
[*] More new parts: T-Connector, X-Connector and Corner.
[*] The colliders on some parts have been tightened up.
[*] A few more parts have been added to the starting set.
[*] Fix a bug where parts would slowly separate over time.
[/list]

To access the beta branch, right click on the game and click Properties -> Betas and then select the "beta" Beta.

Please try it out and let me know what you think!

Ian.

Ian.

notes.title: Early Access Update 2
notes.content:
Hello!

This is a fairly big update with a whole new area, new parts, new cargo and more!

[previewyoutube=j6NMrKQOEFA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]New area[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/f31c075a79a8d4c364bce09eaf7c94724743f116.png[/img]

We've added a new area with 5 new hand-crafted main contracts. The new contracts have you restoring power to a fair for the martians, using a new tool: the grappling hook! 

The fair is in a particularly windy part of Mars where tornadoes are common. Keep an eye out or you might get blown away! (The fair needed to be in a windy area so the wind turbines that power it could generate enough electricity.)

[h2]Fuel[/h2]

Rockets now use fuel. Unlock fuel tanks to extend their range by completing side jobs. Refuel by simply visiting any station or transmitter.

My intent with this change is to keep some of the challenge of navigating the terrain after unlocking the rockets. If you prefer to just fly around without worrying about fuel, you can change that in the new gameplay settings (see below).

[h2]New parts[/h2]

Six new parts have been added.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/d50556b9d791de39f994158eee556c0501953485.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/d50556b9d791de39f994158eee556c0501953485.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/16f9f5805d2cb67388a35bdbced7cb71731b9227.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/16f9f5805d2cb67388a35bdbced7cb71731b9227.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/72ef0e601281b989891ab15786c0ed9e819b62c0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/72ef0e601281b989891ab15786c0ed9e819b62c0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/821b90d77b0fd6b32b4c3ba33a6d3ca8092725aa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/821b90d77b0fd6b32b4c3ba33a6d3ca8092725aa.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/ae4c499e77037014b454cff772edac03add0029c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/ae4c499e77037014b454cff772edac03add0029c.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]The grappling hook can be fired at most static objects and allows you to get to many hard-to-reach places. It's unlocked via a new blueprint.
[*]Light, medium and heavy torsion springs have been added. Torsion springs store rotational energy and act like a hinge that wants to always return to its starting point. They can be unlocked by completing side jobs.
[*]Large and small fuel tanks. These can extend the rocket's range. Beware that fuel adds weight, so the more fuel tanks you use the heavier your vehicle will be when fully fueled!
[/list]

[h2]New side job cargo[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/57f8dd0a8b733e1b9e536adc6e8779831c32caec.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/f60fa91c9efc5cffa24932cc1611eb463dcf3c03.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/53b4d177ed5022c63f23d36ef5692fa342e171e3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/8d812abb15c46bcd371aaab07dcd4e7053f232c9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/63ea971d3e7c133b6a35cde0ad953d68d0b1e36f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/3f81829f93cbdf89b794ecd3fd1f636f3dfdfc5d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/6b7e8b26fb7a79a2ee7fc3bf971a4e5d464b769c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/4a193036d0c1e3d5631457524bee0f56e964672c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/0377f03049763ec15f3c36e07db231adc3f390ce.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c5b50ee23d6bf4dff8e6456ed89ee573c9da4e0b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/9514a7d1f8cad8eefbcfeb1a2be8343cad685b62.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/d1d610ffb059a93d47d93b90bd2f470f00a425fa.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/0a9e83fe440665e68adb895fa5dc1f2520d076c4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/13d3dd1a1b568f4e3416f6297e7174db272199a3.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/ed7f9587815edfcfe7c84f40e51fb50dc373a7db.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c495cfb390c520cbf3b3ec2c7e5233c5b536d111.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/4d1a134641aa974a7ea9dc646c3dc4646e933fef.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/408c502747fdec93d5588edb1cb50334bc0f5c90.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c622d145495f3595ab66bd5cb7176c9aafb50700.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c35ff2e4271df62b54683f61a4b65c8e18f009c0.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New gameplay settings[/h2]

A new tab has been added to the settings menu where you can adjust various gameplay settings. Creative mode is now a preset in this menu and has been removed from the main menu. Note that these settings apply only to the current game and are not global for all games.

[h2]Anything else?[/h2]

We've also made numerous tweaks and fixes including improved performance for vehicles with many wheels and improvements to the camera.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

After a little break, I'm going to focus on some oft requested features and quality of life improvements, fix some long-standing bugs, and finish up some new parts I started working on but didn't finish in time for this release.

As always please let me know if you have any feedback or bug reports using the Steam forums, the official [url=https://discord.gg/tttamKbsNp]Discord[/url] or with the in-game feedback form.

I hope you enjoy the update!

Ian.

notes.title: Early Access Update 1
notes.content:
Hello!

This update includes all the updates from the beta branch as well as a few surprise features such as Steam workshop, creative mode and new parts and cargo!

[previewyoutube=N6hFn6xc3-U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]New parts[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/4966caeeb8d55251dc3c5936597817609dd94e69.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/120a86b09ffc3045bc856f1c90c0d99ab1fee503.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/c10366e0391fe6a69470bca3c6b196bb4eb75f1a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/b56a174f36709db1652046144718b6eddd7201db.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/eab4767af550ea56c66c29240875e3fe9911df5c.png[/img]

There are 6 new parts to discover:

[list]
[*]Light, medium and heavy springs. These are dampened so they can be used as shock absorbers, but also have many other applications!
[*]Ball joint. This is similar to the hinge, but can freely rotate around all 3 axes.
[*]Antenna and End Cap. These are mainly cosmetic. The end cap can be used to visually fill the gap left between hubs or other parts that don't physically connect.
[/list]

[h2]Steam workshop[/h2]

You can now share your designs through Steam workshop! This can be done through the saved designs tab in the editor. It's now also easier to organise your designs with the ability to rename, delete and move them.

There's a new tab in the editor where you can browse and build any workshop items you've subscribed to.

[h2]Creative mode[/h2]

Creative mode is much like the standard mode, except that you have unlimited access to all parts from the start. It's also a great way to try out other player's designs from the workshop if you don't yet have all the parts to build them in standard mode.

[h2]Map improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/46f54fa232c701e3c28745074211e276bfc197ad.png[/img]

The map now shows more detail so it's easier to see where bumpy regions are, and you can plot a detailed route to your destination using up to 32 waypoints. Other changes include updated icons, a map scale and the ability to turn off the contract list so you can see more of the map.

[h2]New side job cargo[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/6e4524eb770397c191ab0c395bdc08709fbb9f32.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/63c68e98eb979402548115b68551a7dc87eb60d0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/1bf1306e6f9fc40aa9449f379e401574358400df.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/0b6d451755884d73b647c510aaf025f618eb255e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811413/d7f085be7ab9aba3149f8e08289d1aa862c3521e.png[/img]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]

The fishery has been redesigned and both the fish and butterfly contracts have been moved to hopefully make them a bit less frustrating. 

The magnetic wheels now corner better on curved surfaces and the stability of the all terrain wheels has been improved.

Support for big picture mode has been improved with the game now pausing when a gamepad is disconnected or the Steam overlay is triggered, as per Valve's guidelines.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

Performance of online co-op when using large vehicles has been greatly improved. 

I also fixed bugs with cargo spawning high in the sky or not triggering the delivery animation, amongst others.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

New stations and main contracts will be coming in the next major update, expected before the end of the year.

Thanks for all the suggestions and support! Please keep 'em coming!

Ian.
